rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the only-report-real-tool-failures prompt rule that followed the invalid holdout11 gate (the model claimed an email failure without calling the tool); never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout12.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout11 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout11 (consumed 2026-11-03: invalid, 12/15 tool turns never called the tool; 2 safety cases scored too strictly).
